rules.directionality: quoter = the side later in canonical order (higher book num; tiebreak chapter, then verse). Only the quoter's verse and the verse immediately preceding it are scanned for formulas; the verbatim-run check compares the quoter's verse to the other verse.
rules.tier1_direct_quotation: EITHER (a) verbatim run: the two verses share a contiguous run of >= 5 identical words (lowercased, punctuation stripped, intra-word dashes joined, stop words kept) AND the pair is cross-testament (see corpus routing below); OR (b) citation formula: the quoter (or preceding) verse contains a formula from QUOTATION_FORMULAS AND shared content-word overlap with the other verse is >= 3 for strong formulas or >= 5 for generic formulas (GENERIC_QUOTATION_FORMULAS); formula-backed hits keep Tier 1 regardless of corpus. Speech-report formulas ('thus saith the lord', 'the word of the lord came', 'god said') are deliberately excluded: they introduce original divine speech, not citations of earlier texts.
rules.verbatim_corpus_routing: same-corpus verbatim parallels are parallel passages (Tier 3) per tier definitions; cross-testament verbatim runs are quotations (Tier 1). Same-corpus verbatim-only hits (OT->OT or NT->NT, no passing citation formula) are same text recorded twice -- Kings/Chronicles, Isa 36-39 || 2 Kgs 18-20, Psalm doublets, synoptic parallels -- and are routed to Tier 3, flagged ambiguous only when the run is exactly at the minimum N.
rules.tier2_fulfillment: quoter (or preceding) verse contains a formula from FULFILLMENT_FORMULAS and the pair did not qualify for Tier 1 (no overlap minimum required, but zero shared content words is flagged ambiguous).
rules.tier3_parallel_passage: same-corpus verbatim run >= 5 words with no passing citation formula (see verbatim_corpus_routing), OR jaccard >= 0.35 AND >=2 shared proper nouns, OR jaccard >= 0.45 alone.
rules.tier4_thematic_echo: jaccard >= 0.15, OR (shared theological terms >= 2 AND vote_band != 'low'), OR (vote_band == 'high' AND shared theological terms >= 1).
rules.evidence: evidence fields (ev_type/ev_detail/ev_shared: the matched formula, verbatim-run length, or jaccard/theological-term figures behind each decision) are published per-reference so any classification can be independently verified.
rules.ambiguous_flag: flags borderline calls without changing the tier. Tier 1 is ambiguous unless a detection path is solid (verbatim run strictly above N, or a formula in the quoter verse itself with overlap strictly above its class minimum); Tier 3 via same-corpus verbatim routing is ambiguous only when the run is exactly N; Tier 2 is ambiguous when overlap is zero or the formula appeared only in the preceding verse; Tiers 3-5 via pass-3 similarity are ambiguous within +/-0.05 of a jaccard threshold or exactly at a theological-term threshold. Full rules: AMBIGUITY RULES comment block in 03_classify.py.
